scope: Definitions and target statements only; no source proof or diagnostic results admitted to blind authors
coordinate_meaning: t denotes length coordinate x0=c*time, not physical time; x,y,z are x1,x2,x3

indices.sum: Repeated spatial indices range over 1,2,3; all coefficients constant in coordinates

parameters.k: arbitrary real 4x3 matrix, rows mu=0..3, columns i=1..3

definitions.notation_collision: S and W here are coefficient matrices sym(M) and skew(M); they are NOT the kinematic shear/vorticity tensors denoted similarly in COMMON_SPEC.

jet_definition.remainder: exp(2*phi0)-1-2*phi0 has coordinate order >=4; this representative has exactly the same metric derivatives through order 3 at origin
jet_definition.requested_curvature_order: G_ab(0) and first partial derivatives d_mu G_ab(0), all 10 symmetric components (40 derivative coefficients)
jet_definition.bianchi: At origin d g=0: for each b=0..3 check sum_a eta^aa d_a G_ab=0, equivalently kappa*d^a T_ab=0. No second derivatives of G and no neighborhood identity inferred from this finite check.
jet_definition.basis: For each named k set that coefficient to 1 and all other k to 0; retain arbitrary b>0. Entries 1 denote the corresponding coefficient basis in the declared units; q_i=-6*b*k_0i, M_ij=-6*b*k_ji.
jet_definition.delta_G_meaning: Homogeneous degree-one Taylor jet of G[g^(0)+H]-G[g^(0)] at origin; not an exact nonlinear identity away from origin.

EF2_evaluation.origin: all coordinates 0; E0=u=partial_0, Ei=partial_i at origin; U=c*u
EF2_evaluation.ray: t=y=z=0,x=s with s real; conformal orthonormal frame E_a=exp(-phi_lambda)*partial_a
EF2_evaluation.epsilon_p_ray: epsilon=T(E0,E0), p2=T(E2,E2); these are frame contractions, not assumed smooth eigenfield away from the ray
EF2_evaluation.branch: future u0>0, g(u,u)=-1; origin eigenvalue -epsilon of T^a_b

targets_not_assumptions.C01: Derive Einstein tensor from EF2 metric; evaluate origin stress, gap and differentiated finite eigenvector equation, acceleration c^2*lambda/(3*b) in direction 1 and zero other rates. Do not assume a tensor formula or neighborhood existence.
targets_not_assumptions.C02: Derive kappa*(epsilon+p2)=exp(b*s**2)*(6*b-2*lambda*s) on the specified ray. lambda=0 is included; s=3*b/lambda only when lambda!=0.
targets_not_assumptions.C03: Verify j2 H=0, full first Einstein jet, all twelve k basis images and delta G_0i=q_i*t+sum_j M_ij*x^j; four origin Bianchi contractions. Derive from metric, not from displayed target.
